title: Intake eval event record
description: One JSONL record per instrumentation event emitted by tests/evals/intake/run.py. Each record is rooted in base_record; the four event $defs carry the judge_rule that says how observed is derived from `opencode run --format json` output. run_error is an operational terminal record, not one of the four measured layers.

route_class.judge_rule: Expected class is the corpus `expect` label. Observed is derived in this order: (1) text containing an explicit capability refusal (无法转账/无法执行/不支持/超出能力/超出范围/cannot/unable) => refuse, checked first because a refusal often includes a numbered 'do it yourself' list (c10); (2) a `question` tool call, or at least two option lines matching `1.`/`1)`/`1）`/`1、`/`A.`/`A)`/`A）` after stripping markdown emphasis and HTML tags, plus a choice cue (选项/请选择/成本价/仓位/希望/偏好/哪个/还是) => clarify_private, unless the text is an artifact (>=3 markdown table rows or a heading containing 结论/结果/报告/清单/回测/净值/体检/归因), because artifacts often end with numbered follow-ups (c04); (3) any `vibe-trading_*`/`ch_*` call with non-empty arguments => execute_with_defaults; (4) otherwise a text-only answer => direct_answer. The artifact guard keeps c04's '下一步' list from reading as a clarification; c05's bold full-width questions are matched after emphasis stripping.

intake_loaded.judge_rule: Observed true when the event stream contains (a) a read-style tool call whose arguments mention a path containing `skills/intake`, (b) an opencode `skill` tool call (name `skill`, `*.skill` or `*_skill`) whose arguments name `intake`, (c) any tool call whose name contains `intake`, or (d) an assistant message that quotes the intake skill name (`intake`). Rule (b) was added on 2026-10-28 after the delivered image shipped the skill: opencode loads project skills through the `skill` tool, which the original path-only rule missed. It cannot retroactively affect `results/baseline.jsonl`, where the skill did not exist. Expected is true only when the item is open-ended (`open_ended: true`) or expects `clarify_private` (c02/c03/c05/c06/c07 in the frozen corpus), and false for the 明确可执行 items and negatives (c01/c04/c08/c09/c10): intake routes only requests that need the funnel or private-slot clarification. A pre-intake baseline observes false everywhere.

question_called.judge_rule: Observed true when any tool part in the stream is named `question` or matches the `question.*` variant namespace; question_count carries the number of such tool calls. Expected is true exactly when the corpus `expect` label is `clarify_private`.

params_compiled.judge_rule: Observed true when any tool call named `vibe-trading_*` (or `vibe_trading_*`) or `ch_*` carries non-empty arguments, i.e. collected options were compiled into tool parameters; tool names the first such call and args_digest is the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON arguments. Expected is true exactly when the corpus `expect` label is `execute_with_defaults`; a first-turn clarify asks for private slots and produces no parameters yet.

run_error.judge_rule: Operational record written when the CLI invocation fails (nonzero exit, timeout, executable missing) or yields no parseable assistant text or tool call; evidence carries the stderr tail capped at 2000 characters. It is terminal for the item and keeps one failed item from aborting the whole run.
